alt: 少年向鄰居道歉後回到社區花圃，戴上手套重新種植並照料幼苗。
scene_prompt: Modern community garden: teenager who had damaged seedlings returns with gloves and watering can, carefully replants and tends them while apologizing to a neighbor; new green shoots beside previously damaged patch, visible constructive change. Warm hopeful, not shame. Natural anatomy, tools held correctly, watering can pours realistically.
